answer: In an agent economy coordinating shipments from orchard to harbor, every agent must lock a refundable bond for 30 days before accepting jobs through the market’s payment bridge. Creating more identities does not bypass the bond: each account locks its own funds, and signed proof that an agent accepted payment but missed a verifiable delivery deadline forfeits its stake. A sybil swarm therefore ties up capital in proportion to its size and risks losing it on failed jobs.
